# Alessio Brini

> Alessio Brini is an Executive in Residence at Duke University's Pratt School of Engineering who works on machine learning for finance and economics, with a focus on decentralized finance and digital assets.

At Duke I work with the Digital Asset Research & Engineering Collaborative (DAREC) and teach in the Master of Engineering in Financial Technology program. I hold a Ph.D. in Mathematical Finance from Scuola Normale Superiore.

Contact: alessio [dot] brini [at] duke [dot] edu

## Research topics

- Machine learning in finance
- Reinforcement learning for sequential decision-making
- Volatility forecasting
- Decentralized finance
- Digital assets and cryptocurrency markets
- Stablecoins
- Financial econometrics

- [About](https://alessiobrini.com/): research focus, teaching, and education
- [Publications](https://alessiobrini.com/publications/): published articles and working papers, with links to each paper and its code
- [Teaching](https://alessiobrini.com/teaching/): graduate courses at Duke on machine learning for FinTech, data wrangling and visualization with Python, and statistics and econometrics

## Published papers

- [On Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Trading with PPO: Challenges and Future Directions](https://doi.org/10.3905/jfds.2026.001). Alessio Brini, Petter N Kolm. The Journal of Financial Data Science, 2026.
- [Beyond Average Hive Performance: Tail Risk Measurement in Italian Apiculture with Honey-at-Risk](https://doi.org/10.1002/env.70106). Alessio Brini, Giacomo Toscano, Ginevra Virginia Lombardi, Maria Elvira Mancino. Environmetrics, 2026.
- [StableAML: Machine Learning for Behavioral Wallet Detection in Stablecoin Anti-Money Laundering on Ethereum](https://doi.org/10.55092/blockchain20260007). Luciano Juvinski, Haochen Li, Alessio Brini. Blockchain, 2026.
- [Graph Neural Networks for Bridge Swap Link Prediction in Uniswap v3](https://doi.org/10.1145/3768292.3770392). Qingran Zhou, Eric Liu, Alessio Brini. Proceedings of the 6th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance, 2025.
- [SpotV2Net: Multivariate intraday spot volatility forecasting via vol-of-vol-informed graph attention networks](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijforecast.2024.11.004). Alessio Brini, Giacomo Toscano. International Journal of Forecasting, 2025. Code: https://github.com/Alessiobrini/SpotV2Net
- [Modeling and simulating a startup ecosystem development with a delayed differential equation](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00500-025-10565-4). Alessio Brini, Viviana Fanelli. Soft Computing, 2025.
- [A comparison of cryptocurrency volatility-benchmarking new and mature asset classes](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40854-024-00646-y). Alessio Brini, Jimmie Lenz. Financial Innovation, 2024.
- [Pricing cryptocurrency options with machine learning regression for handling market volatility](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.econmod.2024.106752). Alessio Brini, Jimmie Lenz. Economic Modelling, 2024.
- [Data-driven Derivative Hedging with Quadratic Variation Penalty](https://doi.org/10.1145/3677052.3698664). Alessio Brini, Giacomo Domeniconi, Ali Fathi. Proceedings of the 5th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance, 2024.
- [Reinforcement learning policy recommendation for interbank network stability](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfs.2023.101139). Alessio Brini, Gabriele Tedeschi, Daniele Tantari. Journal of Financial Stability, 2023.
- [Deep reinforcement trading with predictable returns](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.physa.2023.128901). Alessio Brini, Daniele Tantari. Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, 2023. Code: https://github.com/Alessiobrini/Deep-Reinforcement-Trading-with-Predictable-Returns
- [Assessing the resiliency of investors against cryptocurrency market crashes through the leverage effect](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.econlet.2022.110885). Alessio Brini, Jimmie Lenz. Economics Letters, 2022.

- [Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models: A Comparison with Econometric Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05291). Alessio Brini. arXiv preprint arXiv:2607.05291, 2026. Code: https://github.com/Alessiobrini/tsfm-rv
- [Improving DeFi Accessibility through Efficient Liquidity Provisioning with Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.07508). Haonan Xu, Alessio Brini. arXiv preprint arXiv:2501.07508, 2025. Code: https://github.com/Alessiobrini/deeprl-liquidity-provision-uniswapv3
- [Empirical Models of the Time Evolution of SPX Option Prices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.17511). Alessio Brini, David A Hsieh, Patrick Kuiper, Sean Moushegian, David Ye. arXiv preprint arXiv:2506.17511, 2025.
- [A machine learning approach to forecasting honey production with tree-based methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.01215). Alessio Brini, Elisa Giovannini, Elia Smaniotto. arXiv preprint arXiv:2304.01215, 2023.
- Crypto dynamics during market downturns: Another dotcom boom-bust cycle? Alessio Brini, Jimmie Lenz, Emma Rasiel. Digital Asset Research & Engineering Collaborative, Duke University, 2022.
- [Bitcoin ETFs: Measuring the performance of this new market niche](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4157711). Alessio Brini, Jimmie Lenz. Available at SSRN, 2022.
